what: Legacy arm of mined_under_failed_transport re-mined honestly empty pages:/doc: records on every load because their transport can never be stamped.
how: Verified in source (evidence_for never stamps transport for pages:/doc:). Added `if not reads_as_wiki(host): return False` before the anomalous-host lookup; wiki hosts unchanged, stamped arm unchanged.

what: build() selected pages:/doc: sentinel hosts for a live probe every build.
how: Excluded hosts starting with pages: or doc: from `todo`.

what: sroffset continuation walk had no repeated-token guard.
how: Track seen sroffsets per query; a repeat raises ProbeUnread (unread tail, not cached as a verdict).

what: covered_by credited the aggregate copy over an unparseable shard.
how: Track an unreadable shard (also non-dict); when one exists the aggregate fallback is not consulted, so missing() shows the gap. A deleted shard with a surviving aggregate still counts (the pre-shard case).

what: load_index raised AttributeError on a record that is valid JSON but not an object.
how: isinstance(rec, dict) check inside the try, so it lands in faults['unreadable'].

what: before() on a directory containing state/snapshots copied the store into itself.
how: Up-front realpath check refuses (SnapshotFailed) any directory source that equals or contains ROOT, before dest is created, so nothing is left behind.

what: check_graph only flagged an OWNER row with a literally empty source.
how: Blank/whitespace citation now flagged for every kind (UNSIGNED). Live ledger still closes. The 'anchored to' requirement for parentless OWNER rows is left as a question (Q6).

what: style_audit exited 0 over an empty or unparseable corpus.
how: Returns 1 when no files are found or when zero entries parse; message printed.

what: feats --roll exited 0 when every evidence write was denied.
how: Added a _LANDED counter beside _UNCACHED; rc is nonzero when writes were denied and none landed. The cosmetic _roll_jobs hostless-before-only count is not changed (display only).

what: scope.py, sweep_plan.record and snapshot.before write state with no escalation.assert_clear.
how: Options: (a) add assert_clear to scope.mutate only (SCOPE.json feeds published Magnitude ceilings); (b) add to all three; (c) leave, since none is a chapter-writing path. Needs the owner to say which writers the halt interlock list covers.

what: _units still drops every unit of 400+ characters (order eacc5444288c).
how: Already under an owner order; not re-filed and not touched.

what: MIN_MENTIONS=10 is absolute while the F7 fix made probe text volume far larger; PROBE_VERSION not bumped.
how: Options: scale the floor by corpus size (mentions per 100k chars), keep it absolute, or bump PROBE_VERSION to 3 now. Changing the constant changes every published ceiling and forces a live re-probe of ~155 hosts, so it is a curatorial and cost decision.

what: Seven MEASURED roots have no child and DERIVED physics rows name only constants, not call-time inputs.
how: Options: leave (call-time inputs are not ledger rows), or add the inputs as rows so math_resonance's orphan rate counts them. Changes the reported rate; owner ruling.

what: --roll fails only when errored >= n; a 90% error roll exits 0.
how: Options: keep the all-or-nothing threshold, or trip on a rate (e.g. errored > half). The threshold is a policy number; the roll is a live crawl and a false nonzero restarts it.

what: Eight parentless OWNER rows have no enforced 'anchored to'.
how: Options: require a non-empty parents list or an explicit ROOT marker for OWNER rows, or document parentless OWNER rows as allowed roots. Needs a ruling on which rows are legitimately unanchored.
